newsitem.title: USA: Nashua loses patent litigation vs Ricoh Co.
newsitem.headline: Nashua loses patent litigation vs Ricoh Co.

text.p: Nashua Corp said Thursday that the Federal District Court for New Hampshire has enjoined it from making, using or selling its NT-50 and NT-6750 toner cartridges as a result of patent litigation brought against it by Ricoh Co Ltd.
Nashua said sales of these products in 1996 amounted to less than one percent of its total sales.
Damages in the case have not been determined, the company said.
"The company disagrees with the court's decision to enjoin and plans to appeal," Nashua said in a release.

Nashua sells specialty imaging products. Its products include photofinishing services, thermal papers, pressure-sensitive labels and specialty papers, as well as copier, ink jet and laser printer supplies.
